system.description: For PARTY, ADVENTURERS, MERCENARY PARTY TENSION METER: Each party member suffers 1 fatigue and 1 stress. If a party member suffers 2 fatigue, the GM adds recharge tokens to the party actions equal to the amount of fatigue that party member is suffering from. Then tension resets to zero. ON THE TRAIL: If a member of the Hunting Party is within close range of another member, he gains {Dc} to Observation and Nature Lore for each active talent socketed to this sheet.
